meaning:
1) to tend vines or vineyards, to dress vines or vineyards
1a) (Qal) vinedressers (participle)

elsewhere.note: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock; in the lowland also, and in the plain. He had farmers and vineyard…
Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.
But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.
Be confounded, you farmers! Wail, you vineyard keepers; for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field has perished.
